text:
cara: Hey team — quick Q: where's the panel that shows SM% (per-GPU), GPU memory per-GPU, KV cache hit rate, and avg batch size by pool? Need screenshots/links for a short postmortem. :thinking_face:

dan: Grafana -> Inference / GPU Insights -> 'Pool GPU summary' has most of that. Link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/8f3aGpu/pool-gpu-insights (need VPN). Panels: 'SM utilization (pct)', 'GPU memory used', 'KV cache hit rate', 'Avg batch size by pool'.

ben: For traces use Honeycomb (inference-requests dataset). Example query to find slow requests by pool:
```
service = "runtime"
tag.pool = "prod-transcode"
span.duration_ms > 200
order by span.duration_ms desc
limit 50
```
That'll give you a few sample traces to attach.

aline: Metric names to look for (Prometheus): `sm_utilization_percent`, `gpu_memory_used_bytes`, `gpu_memory_total_bytes`, `kvcache_hit_rate`, `kvcache_evictions_total`, `inference_batch_size_avg` (label `pool`). If you want a per-GPU view, use `instance` label on the GPU metrics.

cara: thx — seeing a bunch of evictions and batch spikes in prod around 03:00 UTC which matches nightly evals. Can we confirm alerts/owners?

dan: Current alerting: `SMHigh` triggers when `avg_over_time(sm_utilization_percent[5m]) > 90` for any pool for 5m. Owner is @kevin. There's also `KVCACHE_EVICTIONS` alert firing at > 100 evictions/min.

ops-bot: :rotating_light: Alert `SMHigh` silenced by kevin for 30 minutes (silence id: s-2026-09-02-03).

kevin: I'll take ownership. For prod-transcode we should probably move to per-pool thresholds — 92 for heavy-transcode, 88 for small-batch pools. I'll open a PR to alerting rules and add a runbook note.

cara: that sounds good. Can you also add a Grafana panel we can link in the postmortem that shows 24h of SM%, KV hit rate, and batch size in one row?

kevin: Yep. Quick PromQL snippets if anyone wants to copy:
`avg_over_time(sm_utilization_percent{pool="prod-transcode"}[5m])`
`rate(kvcache_evictions_total{pool="prod-transcode"}[1m])`
`avg_over_time(inference_batch_size_avg{pool="prod-transcode"}[5m])`
I'll attach the panel link once PR merges.

ben: If you need to correlate a specific request id for traces, include the `x-request-id` header value in Honeycomb — we also log `request_id` as `trace.trace_id` metadata so the link is `https://honeycomb.redwood/events?trace=<TRACE_ID>`

cara: example request id I care about: `req-20260902-03-xxcv`. Can someone paste the trace link when you find it?

dan: Found one: https://honeycomb.redwood/events?trace=4a7f9b2c — looks like a KV eviction spike at the same timestamp, see span `kvcache.lookup` with many misses.

aline: Ops tip: to reduce noise temporarily you can add `for` to the alert or scope it by `pool` label: e.g. `avg_over_time(sm_utilization_percent{pool!="canary"}[5m]) > 90` AND `for: 10m` in the rule. Also consider splitting read-only eval pools into a separate capacity class.

kevin: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/482 — changes alerting to per-pool thresholds and adds panel folder `Postmortems / Prod-transcode`. Will ping when deployed.

cara: awesome — thanks all. Please ping this thread when the grafana panel link is live and when alerts are updated. :thumbsup:

ben: pinged the postmortem doc with the grafana link and attached the trace.

cara: got it, closing my loop here. thank you!
